017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.auth.saml;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.StringUtils.*;
021
022import java.io.*;
023import java.nio.charset.*;
024import java.security.*;
025import java.util.*;
026import java.util.stream.*;

028import org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.*;

031import jakarta.servlet.http.*;

033/**
034 * {@link AuthFilter} that authenticates requests carrying a SAML 2.0 {@code <samlp:Response>} delivered via
035 * the {@link SamlBinding#POST} or {@link SamlBinding#REDIRECT} HTTP binding.
036 *
037 * <p>
038 * On each request this filter:
039 * <ol>
040 *    <li>Inspects the URL path against the configured {@code consumerPath} (default {@code /saml/acs}).  If the
041 *       request path does not match, returns {@link Optional#empty()} (filter does not apply).
042 *    <li>For the {@link SamlBinding#POST} binding: reads the {@code SAMLResponse} form parameter and
043 *       base64-decodes it.  For {@link SamlBinding#REDIRECT}: reads the {@code SAMLResponse} query parameter,
044 *       base64-decodes it, and then DEFLATE-inflates (RFC 1951) per OASIS SAML 2.0 Redirect binding rules.
045 *    <li>Derives the ACS recipient URL (scheme, host, port, and path) from the current request and delegates
046 *       to {@link SamlAssertionValidator#validate(String, String)} with it, so the assertion's bearer
047 *       {@code <SubjectConfirmation>} is always bound to the actual endpoint this request was delivered to
048 *       &mdash; regardless of whether the {@link SamlAssertionValidator} was itself built with
049 *       {@link SamlAssertionValidator.Builder#recipient(String) recipient(...)} configured.  On success,
050 *       builds an {@link AuthResult} carrying the resolved {@link ClaimsPrincipal}.  On failure, re-throws as
051 *       an {@link AuthenticationException} with a {@code WWW-Authenticate: SAML ...} challenge.
052 * </ol>
053 *
054 * <h5 class='topic'>Roles</h5>
055 * <p>
056 * If the resolved {@link ClaimsPrincipal} contains a claim whose name equals the configured
057 * {@code rolesClaim} (default {@code "roles"}) and whose value is a {@link List} of {@link String}, those role
058 * names are populated on the {@link AuthResult}.  Otherwise the role set is empty.
059 *
060 * <h5 class='topic'>Usage</h5>
061 *
062 * <p>
063 * Note that {@code validator} below is <i>not</i> built with
064 * {@link SamlAssertionValidator.Builder#recipient(String) recipient(...)}.  That is safe here because this
065 * filter always derives the ACS recipient from the request and binds it for that call, so bearer
066 * subject-confirmation is enforced regardless of the validator's own configuration.
067 *
068 * <p class='bjava'>
069 *    <jk>var</jk> validator = SamlAssertionValidator.<jsm>create</jsm>()
070 *       .metadataResolver(SamlMetadataResolvers.<jsm>url</jsm>(<js>"https://idp.example.com/metadata"</js>))
071 *       .spEntityId(<js>"https://sp.example.com"</js>)
072 *       .expectedIssuer(<js>"https://idp.example.com"</js>)
073 *       .build();
074 *
075 *    AuthFilterChain.<jsm>create</jsm>(<jv>bs</jv>)
076 *       .append(SamlAuthFilter.<jsm>create</jsm>()
077 *          .consumerPath(<js>"/saml/acs"</js>)
078 *          .binding(SamlBinding.<jsf>POST</jsf>)
079 *          .validator(<jv>validator</jv>)
080 *          .build())
081 *       .build();
082 * </p>
083 *
084 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5>
085 * <ul>
086 *    <li class='jc'>{@link SamlAssertionValidator}
087 *    <li class='jc'>{@link SamlBinding}
088 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://docs.oasis-open.org/security/saml/v2.0/saml-bindings-2.0-os.pdf">SAML 2.0 Bindings (OASIS)</a>
089 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/AuthFilterFramework">AuthN Filter Framework</a>
090 * </ul>
091 *
092 * @since 10.0.0
093 */
094@SuppressWarnings({
095   "java:S1192" // Duplicate string literals are SAML attribute names and HTTP header values; intentional
096})
097public class SamlAuthFilter extends AuthFilter {
098
099   private static final String DEFAULT_CONSUMER_PATH = "/saml/acs";
100   private static final String DEFAULT_ROLES_CLAIM = "roles";
101   private static final String SAML_RESPONSE_PARAM = "SAMLResponse";
102
103   /**
104    * Default ceiling on the number of decompressed bytes accepted from a REDIRECT-binding
105    * {@code SAMLResponse} (1 MiB).
106    */
107   public static final long DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATED_BYTES = 1L * 1024 * 1024;
108
109   /**
110    * Default ceiling on the decompressed-to-compressed size ratio accepted from a REDIRECT-binding
111    * {@code SAMLResponse}.
112    */
113   public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATE_RATIO = 100;
114
115   /**
116    * Static creator.
117    *
118    * @return A new builder.
119    */
120   public static Builder create() {
121      return new Builder();
122   }
123
124   /**
125    * Builder for {@link SamlAuthFilter}.
126    */
127   public static class Builder {
128      private SamlAssertionValidator validator;
129      private SamlBinding binding = SamlBinding.POST;
130      private String consumerPath = DEFAULT_CONSUMER_PATH;
131      private String rolesClaim = DEFAULT_ROLES_CLAIM;
132      private String realm = "saml";
133      private long maxInflatedBytes = DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATED_BYTES;
134      private int maxInflateRatio = DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATE_RATIO;
135
136      /** Constructor. */
137      protected Builder() {}
138
139      /**
140       * Sets the SAML assertion validator.
141       *
142       * @param value The validator.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
143       * @return This object.
144       */
145      public Builder validator(SamlAssertionValidator value) {
146         validator = reqnn("value", value);
147         return this;
148      }
149
150      /**
151       * Sets the SAML binding the filter listens for.  Defaults to {@link SamlBinding#POST}.
152       *
153       * @param value The binding.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
154       * @return This object.
155       */
156      public Builder binding(SamlBinding value) {
157         binding = reqnn("value", value);
158         return this;
159      }
160
161      /**
162       * Sets the request path that carries the SAML assertion.  Defaults to {@code /saml/acs}.
163       *
164       * @param value The request path.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
165       * @return This object.
166       */
167      public Builder consumerPath(String value) {
168         consumerPath = reqnb("value", value);
169         return this;
170      }
171
172      /**
173       * Sets the claim name used to extract roles from the resolved {@link ClaimsPrincipal}.
174       *
175       * @param value The claim name.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
176       * @return This object.
177       */
178      public Builder rolesClaim(String value) {
179         rolesClaim = reqnb("value", value);
180         return this;
181      }
182
183      /**
184       * Sets the {@code WWW-Authenticate: SAML realm="<value>"} challenge realm.
185       *
186       * @param value The realm.  Must not be <jk>null</jk> or blank.
187       * @return This object.
188       */
189      public Builder realm(String value) {
190         realm = reqnb("value", value);
191         return this;
192      }
193
194      /**
195       * Sets the ceiling on the number of decompressed bytes accepted from a {@link SamlBinding#REDIRECT}
196       * {@code SAMLResponse}.  Defaults to {@link SamlAuthFilter#DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATED_BYTES}.
197       *
198       * <p>
199       * A REDIRECT-binding {@code SAMLResponse} is DEFLATE-compressed in transit, so a small query-string
200       * payload can expand to a much larger document.  Decompression stops and the request is rejected once
201       * the running output exceeds this cap, so a highly-compressible payload cannot drive an unbounded
202       * allocation.  A value {@code <= 0} disables the absolute cap (the ratio guard still applies).
203       *
204       * @param value The maximum decompressed size in bytes.
205       * @return This object.
206       */
207      public Builder maxInflatedBytes(long value) {
208         maxInflatedBytes = value;
209         return this;
210      }
211
212      /**
213       * Sets the ceiling on the decompressed-to-compressed size ratio accepted from a
214       * {@link SamlBinding#REDIRECT} {@code SAMLResponse}.  Defaults to
215       * {@link SamlAuthFilter#DEFAULT_MAX_INFLATE_RATIO}.
216       *
217       * <p>
218       * This guard catches a highly-compressible payload even when the absolute
219       * {@link #maxInflatedBytes(long) byte cap} is generous.  A value {@code <= 0} disables the ratio guard.
220       *
221       * @param value The maximum output-to-input ratio.
222       * @return This object.
223       */
224      public Builder maxInflateRatio(int value) {
225         maxInflateRatio = value;
226         return this;
227      }
228
229      /**
230       * Builds the filter.
231       *
232       * @return A new {@link SamlAuthFilter}.
233       */
234      public SamlAuthFilter build() {
235         if (validator == null)
236            throw new IllegalStateException("SamlAuthFilter requires a SamlAssertionValidator");
237         return new SamlAuthFilter(this);
238      }
239   }
240
241   private final SamlAssertionValidator validator;
242   private final SamlBinding binding;
243   private final String consumerPath;
244   private final String rolesClaim;
245   private final String challenge;
246   private final long maxInflatedBytes;
247   private final int maxInflateRatio;
248
249   /**
250    * Constructor.
251    *
252    * @param b The builder to read configuration from.
253    */
254   protected SamlAuthFilter(Builder b) {
255      this.validator = b.validator;
256      this.binding = b.binding;
257      this.consumerPath = b.consumerPath;
258      this.rolesClaim = b.rolesClaim;
259      this.challenge = "SAML realm=\"" + b.realm + "\"";
260      this.maxInflatedBytes = b.maxInflatedBytes;
261      this.maxInflateRatio = b.maxInflateRatio;
262   }
263
264   @Override /* Overridden from AuthFilter */
265   public Optional<AuthResult> authenticate(HttpServletRequest req) throws AuthenticationException {
266      if (!matchesPath(req))
267         return oe();
268      var raw = req.getParameter(SAML_RESPONSE_PARAM);
269      if (isEmpty(raw))
270         return oe();
271      var xml = decodeSamlResponse(raw);
272      var principal = runValidator(xml, deriveRecipient(req));
273      return o(AuthResult.of(principal, extractRoles(principal)));
274   }
275
276   private boolean matchesPath(HttpServletRequest req) {
277      var p = req.getPathInfo();
278      var s = p != null ? p : req.getServletPath();
279      return s != null && s.equals(consumerPath);
280   }
281
282   /**
283    * Derives the ACS recipient URL (scheme, host, port, and path) that this request was actually delivered
284    * to, so it can be bound to the assertion's bearer {@code <SubjectConfirmation>}.
285    *
286    * <p>
287    * Normally this is just {@link HttpServletRequest#getRequestURL()}.  Some servlet-container and test
288    * request implementations return <jk>null</jk> from that method, so as a fallback the URL is
289    * reconstructed from {@link HttpServletRequest#getScheme()}, {@link HttpServletRequest#getServerName()},
290    * {@link HttpServletRequest#getServerPort()} (omitted when it's the scheme's default port), and
291    * {@link HttpServletRequest#getRequestURI()}.  If the recipient still cannot be determined, the request
292    * is rejected via {@link AuthenticationException} &mdash; never with an {@link NullPointerException}.
293    *
294    * @param req The current request; {@link #matchesPath} has already confirmed its path matches
295    *    {@code consumerPath}.
296    * @return The recipient URL, e.g. {@code https://sp.example.com/saml/acs}.
297    * @throws AuthenticationException If the recipient URL cannot be determined from the request.
298    */
299   private String deriveRecipient(HttpServletRequest req) throws AuthenticationException {
300      var url = req.getRequestURL();
301      if (url != null)
302         return url.toString();
303      return reconstructRecipient(req);
304   }
305
306   /**
307    * Fallback for {@link #deriveRecipient(HttpServletRequest)} when {@link HttpServletRequest#getRequestURL()}
308    * returns <jk>null</jk>.
309    *
310    * @param req The current request.
311    * @return The reconstructed recipient URL.
312    * @throws AuthenticationException If {@code scheme}, {@code serverName}, or {@code requestURI} is
313    *    <jk>null</jk> or blank, so no recipient can be determined.
314    */
315   private String reconstructRecipient(HttpServletRequest req) throws AuthenticationException {
316      var scheme = req.getScheme();
317      var host = req.getServerName();
318      var uri = req.getRequestURI();
319      if (isBlank(scheme) || isBlank(host) || isBlank(uri))
320         throw new AuthenticationException("Unable to derive SAML ACS recipient from request").wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
321      var port = req.getServerPort();
322      var isDefaultPort = port <= 0
323         || (port == 80 && eqic("http", scheme))
324         || (port == 443 && eqic("https", scheme));
325      var sb = new StringBuilder(scheme).append("://").append(host);
326      if (!isDefaultPort)
327         sb.append(':').append(port);
328      return sb.append(uri).toString();
329   }
330
331   private String decodeSamlResponse(String raw) throws AuthenticationException {
332      try {
333         byte[] decoded = Base64.getMimeDecoder().decode(raw);
334         return switch (binding) {
335            // Per SAML 2.0 Redirect binding: raw DEFLATE (no zlib wrapper), decompressed under a hard
336            // output-size cap and ratio guard so a compressible payload cannot force an unbounded allocation.
337            case REDIRECT -> new String(IoUtils.inflate(decoded, true, maxInflatedBytes, maxInflateRatio), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
338            // Per SAML 2.0 POST binding: the base64-decoded bytes are the raw XML document.
339            case POST -> new String(decoded, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
340         };
341      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
342         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "SAMLResponse parameter is not valid base64")
343            .wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
344      } catch (IOException e) {
345         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "SAMLResponse parameter could not be inflated (REDIRECT binding)")
346            .wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
347      }
348   }
349
350   private Principal runValidator(String xml, String recipient) throws AuthenticationException {
351      try {
352         var p = validator.validate(xml, recipient);
353         if (p == null)
354            throw new AuthenticationException("SAML validator returned null").wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
355         return p;
356      } catch (AuthenticationException e) {
357         var hasChallenge = e.getHeaders().stream()
358            .anyMatch(h -> eqic("WWW-Authenticate", h.getName()));
359         if (!hasChallenge)
360            e.wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
361         throw e;
362      } catch (RuntimeException e) {
363         throw new AuthenticationException(e, "SAML validation failed").wwwAuthenticate(challenge);
364      }
365   }
366
367   @SuppressWarnings({
368      "unchecked" // Type erasure on reflective/generic cast; element type is verified at call site
369   })
370   private Set<String> extractRoles(Principal principal) {
371      if (principal instanceof ClaimsPrincipal principal2) {
372         var v = principal2.getClaims().get(rolesClaim);
373         if (v instanceof List<?> v2) {
374            return ((List<Object>) v2).stream()
375               .filter(String.class::isInstance)
376               .map(String.class::cast)
377               .collect(Collectors.toCollection(HashSet::new));
378         }
379      }
380      return Collections.emptySet();
381   }
382}
